title: Brushing Doubts Aside
goal: Say that a doubt does not change what follows, with de todos modos, de todas formas and en cualquier caso.

items: I can say that a doubt does not change what follows, with de todos modos, de todas formas and en cualquier caso.
I can tell this apart from a contrast with sin embargo.
I can use the new words for doubts and decisions.
